AgentStateScope.description:
What one working state belongs to. The id travels in the body, never in a URL: a conversation id may
look like a phone number.
AgentStateScope.title: AgentStateScope

AgentStateWrite.description:
A write of an agent's working state, by its code and never by a model: `cas` replaces the whole state
at `if_version` (0 when it must not exist yet); `merge_by_key` replaces each top-level field it names and
removes a field written as exactly `{"$delete": true}`.
AgentStateWrite.title: AgentStateWrite

AttributionReport.description: Value by method and band, deterministic and probable apart; weights are never summed as money.
AttributionReport.title: AttributionReport

Change.description: One entry of the change log the bisection walks.
Change.title: Change

ContactKeys.description: The spaces' Ed25519 public keys a gateway checks a contact token with, offline.
ContactKeys.title: ContactKeys

ContentMarker.description: A content field whose text Niadra does not hold (`pointer`, `hash_only`), or holds under scan.

pointer.description: Where the SDK reads the text inside the company's boundary.
pointer.title: Pointer

ContentMarker.title: ContentMarker

FieldState.description:
One field as a read serves it: the value with its logical value, stamps, source and observer, and the
freshness computed now against the type's current rule.

known_at.description: When Niadra first knew it; never moves.
known_at.title: Known At

masked.description: The reader's access masks the value: `v` is absent.
masked.title: Masked

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value.
observed_at.title: Observed At

FieldState.title: FieldState

Handle.description: An identifier of a subject in some channel or system: a phone, an e-mail, a CRM id.

scope.description: Namespace for scoped identifiers: the WhatsApp Business account for `wa_bsuid`, the system for `system_id`, the country for `gov_id_hmac`.
scope.title: Scope

subject_kind.description: Defaults to `person`, except for organization-only handle types.

Handle.title: Handle

Notification.description: A webhook's body, for who pulls instead of receiving it: the same body, in `change_seq` order.
Notification.title: Notification

version.description: The source's version of the object. A field moves only when this is greater than the version that last wrote it; a source never reuses a version for other content.
version.title: Version

ObjectPushResponse.description:
How many items of the request each decision took, against the hot layer, with no database statement.

A shared object's item is `applied` when at least one of its fields moved forward: reads serve it at once,
and the consolidator writes it within a second with the same per-field rule, so the stored object never
disagrees with the answer. `stale_version`: every field was already written by this version or a greater
one, as a retried request finds. `out_of_set`: the object is not in the working set, and nothing is kept.
A subject's object is `recorded`: accepted as a system event about it, in the request's one statement,
and its fields move by the same rule when the event is applied.
ObjectPushResponse.title: ObjectPushResponse

ObjectRead.description:
One object as a state read serves it: fields with four logical values and their stamps, computed
values, lifecycle, timers and readings, and what may not be claimed with data this old. A read never
refuses; a `decide` read of a type that asks for it carries `refusal` beside the values, for the company's
tool.

expired_by.description: The inputs whose change expired it.
expired_by.title: Expired By

withheld.description: Fields left out for this reader, and why.
withheld.title: Withheld

ObjectRead.title: ObjectRead

ObjectRef.description: A business object in a system of record, e.g. `invoice` / `erp` / `0823`.
ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef

ObjectSnapshotRequest.description: Reconciliation from an NDJSON file uploaded through the file path that exists (`/v1/ingest`).
ObjectSnapshotRequest.title: ObjectSnapshotRequest

state.description: A canonical state of the type, or `expired_without_outcome`.
state.title: State

PreviousValue.description: A field's value before its latest change, kept for the fields that declare `track_changes`.
PreviousValue.title: PreviousValue

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` comes from the versioned error catalog.
Problem.title: Problem

PromoteRequest.description:
Moves turns from the short tier (every turn, 7 days) to the kept one, by conversation or by id, with
the reason: the complaint arrives days after the turn.
PromoteRequest.title: PromoteRequest

not_found.description: Turns no longer in the short tier, or never recorded.
not_found.title: Not Found

Provenance.description:
Where pushed values come from: only a `live` source sustains a claim, and the age of every value counts
from `source_observed_at`.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ReadingResult.description:
A named reading's value, as niadra-expr computes it: the logical value, and the kind and value when
known (dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, times in UTC, durations in milliseconds).
ReadingResult.title: ReadingResult

ReplayCase.description:
What the SDK's replay runner needs to run the turn again inside the customer's boundary: the frame,
pointers and hashes, pins, the pack and view of the time, the masked history up to the turn and the
suggested assertions. A pin that does not match stops the case with `pin_mismatch`.
ReplayCase.title: ReplayCase

ReviewRequestCreate.description: A request to review an automated decision (LGPD, art. 20), sent to the controller's DPO.
ReviewRequestCreate.title: ReviewRequestCreate

ScenarioFromReport.description: A bug report becomes a scenario: its turns are promoted and assertions suggested by rule.
ScenarioFromReport.title: ScenarioFromReport

ScenarioRunCreate.description: The customer's CI reports N executions of the scenarios; the statistics stay with Niadra.
ScenarioRunCreate.title: ScenarioRunCreate

SdkProfile.description:
What the SDK keeps in its local cache: the features on, the source's tool bindings, the summarized
type registry, the claim contract and turn recording.
SdkProfile.title: SdkProfile

StateRef.description: An object of the type registry: a subject's or a shared one, whose key may name a variant.
StateRef.title: StateRef

due_at.description: Computed now from the rule and the values.
due_at.title: Due At

name.description: The agent's name inside the source, e.g. `closing`.
name.title: Name

parent_turn_id.description: The turn that opened this one as a sub-turn (a sub-agent, an agent as tool).
parent_turn_id.title: Parent Turn Id

TurnBlob.description:
A large value of the record. `sha256` is over its normalized canonical JSON (RFC 8785): the same value
always has the same hash.

content.description: The value itself, only in `stored` mode.
content.title: Content

pointer.description: Where the customer keeps it, in `pointer` mode.
pointer.title: Pointer

TurnBlob.title: TurnBlob

adapter.description: The framework adapter and its version, if any.
adapter.title: Adapter

TurnCall.description: One tool or model call of the turn, copied deep at the moment it happened.

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

name.description: The tool's name, or the model's for a model call.
name.title: Name

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_model.description: The result as the model saw it.
result_model.title: Result Model

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

result_ui.description: The result as the interface got it.
result_ui.title: Result Ui

TurnCall.title: TurnCall

TurnClaim.description:
A claim contract verdict, found by the SDK before the text reached the customer or a document. The
fields are the claim contract's record; its spec fixes the vocabularies of `verdict` and
`action`, so this record takes them as names until that model replaces this one.

span.description: Start and end offsets in the output.
span.title: Span

TurnClaim.title: TurnClaim

compiler.description: The context compiler's version, from the pack.
compiler.title: Compiler

pack_hash.description: The hash of the pack this turn read.
pack_hash.title: Pack Hash

TurnConstraints.description: What the SDK measured of the constraints block on one tool call: sent, checked, violated.

constraints.description: The version of the constraints block applied.
constraints.title: Constraints

TurnConstraints.title: TurnConstraints

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

anchor.description: The quoted text a fact is anchored to.
anchor.title: Anchor

TurnInteraction.description:
What the person was shown or did in the turn. Its fields are the `interaction.v0` spec's,
validated when the turn is applied; until that spec's `Interaction` model lands, the record fixes only
the kind and keeps the rest as it came. The swap narrows the type and changes no document.
TurnInteraction.title: TurnInteraction

TurnObservation.description: State a tool result showed, with provenance per field; without provenance it is display only.
TurnObservation.title: TurnObservation

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

document.description: A document the turn wrote, by its blob.
document.title: Document

event_keys.description: The events `track()` sent for what the turn said: the text is never repeated here.
event_keys.title: Event Keys

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

TurnPins.description:
What must be the same for a replay to reproduce this turn. The recording document says which are
required; a turn without one of them is kept, marked not replayable.

assembler.description: The version of the company's context assembler.
assembler.title: Assembler

corpus_digest.description: Digest of the files the agent consults, computed in the SDK; never the files.
corpus_digest.title: Corpus Digest

model.description: The exact model the agent called.
model.title: Model

tool_schemas.description: Tool name -> hash of its schema.
tool_schemas.title: Tool Schemas

TurnPins.title: TurnPins

TurnRead.description: A read the turn made from Niadra, by its version: the pack by ETag, a block by its version.

anyOf.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

blob.description: The content read, when the recording keeps it.
blob.title: Blob

TurnRead.title: TurnRead

TurnRecord.description:
One turn, from its input (a message, an interface action, an event, a timer firing) to the last thing
it emitted to the customer or to a document.

propertyNames.description: A blob of this record, by its key in `blobs`, e.g. `b:1`.

TurnRecord.title: TurnRecord

TurnSearchRequest.description: A search over the kept tier. The conversation id travels in the body, never in the URL.
TurnSearchRequest.title: TurnSearchRequest

TurnView.description: A recorded turn as the viewer shows it. In `pointer` and `hash_only` modes, blobs have no content.

replayable.description: Every pin the recording requires is there.
replayable.title: Replayable

TurnView.title: TurnView

TurnsResponse.description: 200 when every turn was taken, 207 with one error per rejected turn (by index).

duplicates.description: Turns already recorded: the same turn sent twice is one.
duplicates.title: Duplicates

TurnsResponse.title: TurnsResponse

ValueState.description: A value the company computed, kept as a versioned fact with the rule that produced it.

absent_as.description: The name of the absence, when absent.
absent_as.title: Absent As

ValueState.title: ValueState
